pr_title: Only fadeout beatmap metadata when it's visible and required
pr_body:
This fixes #9335.
When the title of Beatmap Details Metadata was empty, it would display the container and then fade it out, resulting in the bouncing animation.
Changing `this.FadeOut();` to `this.Hide();` was everything needed.
pr_comments: This is changing behaviour when switching from a beatmap showing text to not showing text.

comments: I'd like to work on this issue. I've read the contributing guidelines.

The previous attempt at fixing this that I had reservations with is linked above - there's a suggestion of a resolution there, and also some paper trail as to why the current code is shaped the way it is. Please let us know if you need anything else.

review_comments:
I don't think this is a proper fix, either. It's pretty hacky to say the least.

The core problem here is that the metadata section is initially visible while it should probably not be. I think the way this should be fixed is by setting `Alpha = 0` in the ctor of `MetadataSection` (but *not* moving it out of the nested `FillFlowContainer` - see discussion in #3632 for the reason why). Eyeballing it that solution seems to work ok but I haven't tested it too thoroughly, so buyer beware.

Keeping that above PR in mind (this is an ages-old regression, it seems), I'd be much more comfortable with this change in general if it had visual test cases attached.
